query: UPDATE diagrams SET title = $1, diagram_type = $2, data = CAST($3 AS jsonb), is_public = $4, updated_by = $5, updated_at = $6, version = version + $9 WHERE id = $7 AND version = $8 RETURNING version, created_at, updated_at

INSERT INTO diagrams (id, title, diagram_type, data, version, is_public, owner_id, updated_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, CAST($4 AS jsonb), $5, $6, $7, $8, COALESCE($9, now()), COALESCE($10, now())) RETURNING created_at, updated_at

INSERT INTO diagram_versions (id, diagram_id, version_number, data, note, created_by, created_at) SELECT $1, d.id, COALESCE((SELECT max(version_number) FROM diagram_versions WHERE diagram_id = d.id), $6) + $7, d.data, $2, $3, $4 FROM diagrams d WHERE d.id = $5 RETURNING version_number

UPDATE diagrams d SET data = v.data, version = d.version + $5, updated_by = $1, updated_at = $2 FROM diagram_versions v WHERE d.id = $3 AND v.id = $4 AND v.diagram_id = d.id RETURNING d.id, d.title, d.diagram_type, d.data, d.version, d.is_public, d.owner_id, d.updated_by, d.created_at, d.updated_at
